title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
snippet: This news article reports on a significant research study by Fabio Giglietto, Professor of Internet Studies at the University of Urbino, analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts. The study reveals how Meta's algorithmic changes cut the reach of mainstream Italian parliamentarians by an average of 72% while leaving extremist accounts unaffected. Giglietto is quoted heavily on the 'asymmetric effects' of these algorithmic choices.
description: A news article detailing a study by Fabio Giglietto on how Meta's algorithmic adjustments have drastically reduced the Facebook reach of mainstream Italian politicians.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: This coverage details the public and political fallout from Fabio Giglietto's research paper, 'A Pretty Blunt Approach'. The article outlines how Giglietto's findings on the demotion of political content on Meta were featured on Rai3's investigative show 'Report' and went on to spark an official European Parliament inquiry into Meta's algorithmic transparency and systemic risks under the Digital Services Act.
description: An article detailing how Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithmic demotion of political content was featured on Rai3's 'Report' and sparked an official European Parliament inquiry under the Digital Services Act.

title: Report - Puntata del 12/04/2026
snippet: The April 12, 2026 episode of Rai3's investigative journalism series 'Report' prominently featured Professor Giglietto's algorithmic research. description: An investigative segment on Rai 3's program 'Report' highlighting Fabio Giglietto's research into Meta's recommendation algorithms and their impact on democracy.
